top_signals.title: Wall Street Week | Rerouting Global Trade, Private Equity Tested, Realizing Cuba’s Potential
top_signals.summary: This week, inflation may be edging lower, but as markets push rates higher, the Fed’s 2% inflation target might be a long way off. And, Mexico is building a land-based trade corridor that could give shipping companies more options when traditional channels are disrupted. Plus, as exits slow and borrowing costs rise, the ability of private equity investments to generate returns that beat public markets is less certain.  Later, Cuba is promising its biggest market reforms in decades, but investors remain skeptical that the state will truly give up control.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: We Support Zuckerberg's Vision: Cassidy
top_signals.summary: Lauren Cassidy, CIO at Founders 100 ETF, joins Scarlet Fu and Athanasios Psarofagis on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discuss the Founders 100 ETF (ticker: FFF), the possible merger between Tesla and SpaceX, and how Meta is seeking to raise as much as $95B from selling common and preferred stock. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
